description: Dr.Shobhana Bhatia spoke about the "Gut Health" Dr. Bhatia has a distinguished academic & research career. She specialises in IBD & Liver diseases. She has authored over 200 research papers & collected many awards during her extraordinary work life. She described the stomach as a mixer that churns what we eat and how the intestines segregate the food into digestive ingredients & waste. Dr. Bhatia states that the sign of a healthy gut includes: Regular bowel habits, Normal hunger, good immunity system, Healthy skin, Good mood & attitude. She recommends to eat simple home cooked food & Yoga to reduce stress and maintain balance in our lives.
